English: Perhaps you could indulge me.
Are you sure? It is a tale of woe and misfortune, inspector.
I was once hailed as the culinary maestro of Paris.
Right up until my shameful secret was exposed.
Shunned by all my peers, I ended up here.
Tell me, what was your secret?
Are you sure you want to know?
I'm positive.
Alright. You see, I was burdened with...
...a geographic tongue.
What? That's your shameful secret?
A side effect of this affliction is a high sensitivity to seasoning.
I assure you, it's a wretched curse in this line of work, inspector.
As such, I relied on others to sample my creations for me.
However, one fateful evening I was caught out.
With my reputation ruined, I was banished from Paris in disgrace.
So you were ousted from culinary society?
Of course. What self-respecting chef is unwilling to sample their own cooking?
Lady Unterwald took me under her wing, when no-one else would.
Are you crying?
N-No, it's all these onions!
This is why I have Remy sample my dishes.
That will be all for now.
Very well.
What dish are you preparing over here?
Ah, we're preparing Oysters with sauce mignonette tonight.
I've got to shuck all the oysters in this sack first, though.
Have you ever found a pearl while shucking oysters?
Hah! I wish. They're extremely rare.
I could shuck thousands of oysters, and still never see one!
Hah. Well, perhaps it will be your lucky day?
If you say so, inspector!
What are your duties in the kitchen?
I'll typically be in charge of your hot appetisers, soups, vegetable dishes... that sort of thing.
But really, I just do what I'm told!
Do you perform any other kitchen duties?
Well, I'll occasionally assist the Chef de Cuisine with their taste tests!
He doesn't have much of a tolerance due to his condition, you see.
Why do you have to taste all the dishes?
You've got to taste everything before it's plated, inspector.
You wouldn't know if a dish is properly seasoned, otherwise!
The Chef de Cuisine is a little sensitive, so I take on that role for him.
Have there been any reported sightings of vermin?
I hope not, I can't stand the sight of them!
Their quick, t-twitchy movements...
Those s-sharp, gnawing teeth?
Don't forget their beady little eyes.
Augh! It gives me the creeps!
Are you suggesting you're afraid of rodents?
There's nothing wrong with suriphobia! It's extremely common, you know?
Y-you shouldn't talk to me about it, though. You're stressing me out!
I'll let you get back to work
Merci, inspector.
I'm your new hire, of course! Don't you remember?
I don't require additional staff, you are mistaken.
You'd be more hindrance than help, no?
I'm the health inspector, were you not informed of my arrival?
Inspecteur ? Il ne manquait plus ça !
You expect me to just take your word for it? Ha!
If you come to inspect my kitchen, you better bring identification.
You mean you don't recognise me?
Am I to recognise every vagrant who enters my kitchen claiming to be a health inspector?
Don't be absurd!
This attitude will reflect poorly on your health inspection.
Too bad! Now go and cry elsewhere!
I'll have to mark you down for that, I'm afraid.
This is my kitchen, you don't intimidate me.
I'll be right back!
Don't hurry back, now.
I believe this badge should serve as satisfactory identification.
Hah! You think I can be tricked by a cheap toy for children?
You'll have to do better than that.
Ah, my mistake. I'll be back with the correct badge.
I believe this badge will serve as satisfactory identification?
Oh la vache ! Please accept my apologies, inspector.
Mon dieu ! I hoped this day would never come.
May I have a look around?
But of course!
Dépêchez-vous !
Get to your stations, this is not a drill!
Ah, I seem to have misplaced my badge!
I'll be right back!
Don't hurry back, now.
'Tis I, Herman Merman -- food critic extraordinaire!
Herman who? Nobody's ever heard of you, monsieur!
We're already sweating! We don't need any more publicity!
This isn't the bathroom? I'll just be on my way.
Get out!
Have you travelled on the Reuss Express before?
Oh yes, wherever Lady Unterwald goes, I follow!
I wouldn't be a very good physician if I wasn't with my patient!
I thought you'd like to know I'm researching ideas for my next novel!
How exciting, I can hardly wait to read it!
Perhaps you could give me a little sneak peek?
Ah, I'm afraid it's very much a draft right now.
Early days, I understand! Just let me know if you need any ideas!
Full of ideas, are you? What do you propose?
Well, maybe there could be an incredible doctor who assists you in solving crimes?
A detective and a doctor solving crimes together? That sounds a little outlandish.
Ah, perhaps I haven't explained it right. They would be best of friends!
And also, the doctor is really cool. He'd be a bit of a ladies man, you see?
Hrmm. Pass.
Ohhh. That's okay, I have other ideas!
Any other novel ideas you'd like to propose?
Maybe you'd have to solve a crime, at the local hospital!
Is this about that doctor character again?
No! It's a totally new idea, I promise!
You see, Herman would have to go undercover... as a patient!
He'd literally be under the cover, you see? Listening in on all the incriminating conversations!
So I'd be bedridden and pretending to be unconscious the entire time?
Yes! That's it!
Now, in order to sell the cover story, perhaps there could be a physician in the room, nursing you back to health.
So, there would be a doctor?
No, they would be playing pretend! It's completely different.
Pass.
Ohhhh.
I may regret this, but any other ideas you'd care to propose?
Okay, what about this...
Herman is assigned a case, deep in the jungle!
This sounds more like it!
Now, the location is so remote that it would only be accessible by plane, you see?
While you are up in the air, you begin to choke on a packet of complimentary peanuts...
Luckily, there is-
Let me guess. A doctor aboard the plane comes to my rescue?
H-how did you know that?!
Okay, I think I've heard enough.
Ohhh.
I cannot believe I'm asking this. Do you have any other ideas?
Of course! But, I don't think you'd care to hear them.
Do you know where I can find Mr Liu?
Hmm, I did see him enter the green room a while ago.
It's guest list only, but I'm sure those detective skills of yours could wrangle you in!
I have to leave.
Let me know if you need anything, detective.
You mentioned a speech tonight?
That's right, I've got quite the announcement planned!
But would you believe it's got everyone in a full panic?
What kind of announcement are you making?
Between you and me, I'm passing over my empire!
The entire Wald-Bahn operation?
Oh, yes! And I'm quite enjoying the spectacle of it all.
You're not planning to sell to Mr Liu?
Heavens, no!
He's only desperate to get his hands on us because we're his biggest competitor.
At the end of the day, this is a fight over the future of rail transport.
The Reuss Express is all the proof I need to show we can do it without diesel!
Why is Mr Liu trying to win you over?
Oh, he's not interested in me, dear!
Jian thinks that by cosying up to me, I'll be more inclined to consider his business proposal.
That tactic is nearly as old as I am, if you can believe that!
I need access to the green room, backstage!
Whatever for? You're not here to rub shoulders with the band, you know!
I tried to follow Mr Liu back there, but I wasn't on the guest list.
Well, you'll just have to use that head of yours, Herman!
Anything I should know about the family business?
Well, let's see...
My treasurer seems to be so terrible with money, he goes as white as a sheet whenever I ask him about the finances!
Our main competitor has attempted to launch a charm offensive.
My sister-in-law will be attempting to interject herself into my plans at every opportunity.
She'll have roped those dim-witted nephews into doing the heavy lifting, of course.
And to add insult to injury, my personal physician is trying to get me to take up Pilates!
Perhaps I should be selling up, now that I think about it!
I should get back to it!
That is what I'm paying you for, detective.
Do you know Mr Liu? I'm looking for him.
Mr Liu was here, alright. But he didn't stay long.
What did you want with Mr Liu?
I'm supposed to be keeping an eye on him!
You're spying on him? Listen, he probably wouldn't appreciate that.
I'd keep that to yourself!
You didn't happen to see him doing anything nefarious?
No more than usual, I suspect!
He's got charm alright, but there's something underneath it all...
I just need to know, what was he doing here?
He said he needed to adjust something backstage, I didn't ask what.
He's gone? But I didn't see him leave!
I think he went backstage to adjust something, probably slipped out when nobody was looking.
You're in Balboa Swing, right? I'm a huuge fan!
Susanne Goldschmidt, the golden canary.
Herman Merman, detective extraordinaire.
Always a pleasure to meet an admirer, detective.
Just don't make me call security on you.
I hear you're represented by Beverly Moore?
Indeed. You know, it was Moore's idea to pair me with Balboa Swing.
Mm-hmm. We've never sounded better!
That's the kind of shrewd business decision-making we can all get behind!
Do you think ‘Moore Or Less' would represent me?
I don't know, are you adequately talented?
I believe I meet the minimum requirements.
That's the spirit. Keep talking like that, and you'll be a shoo-in!
Are you alright? What are those noises you're making?
I'm just warming up the vocals.
Warming up?
It's part of my routine. Just your basic humming, lip trills, tongue twisters... That sort of thing!
It usually works, but I'm not feeling it today.
Hey, I've got an idea. Why not try it with me?
Hmm...
Oh, come on! Don't be such a square. I need your help to warm up, here!
Fine, let's do some humming!
Great! Let's hum the arpeggio!
Hum - Hmmm - Hmmm - Hmmm - Hummm- Hmmm- hmmmm!
Huu-Hrrrmm-Hnnn-Hmm-HMmmmmm-Hmm-HMMmmm!
Not bad, but it could use some work.
We could attempt lip trills, I suppose!
Alright, watch and learn.
Brrrrrrrrrr! Rrrrrrrrr! Brrrrr!
Bfffffrr! Rfffff! Bfffrrr!
Almost! You just need a bit of practice, that's all.
Alright, let's try a tongue twister!
Okay, watch this!
Unique New York, unique New York, unique New York.
How much wood could a woodchuck chuck if a woodchuck could chuck wood?
She sells seashells by the sea shore!
Pretty cool, huh? But it's not quite hitting the spot just yet.
Do you know any good ones we can try?
Let's see. How about...
Ooh, fun.
Herman Merman and the Murmuring German!
Herman Merman and the Sermon of Vermin?
Interesting!
Herman Merman and the Sermon of Vermin!
Excellent!
Herman Merman and the Squirmin' Chairman!
Wonderful!
Herman Merman and the Squirmin' Chairman!
Yes, I like that one!
Ooh yes, that's helping!
I can feel a great weight lifting, already!
That's loosened the jaw, alright!
Yes, I think that's done it! My resonators and articulators are firing on all cylinders!
Thanks for the help!
No problem at all.
So, you're all warmed up. Are you going to sing now?
When do you think you'll be ready, boys?
Looks like it's going to be a while.
Listen, we've got to figure a way out of here!
Look around your cell, see what you can find!
Just sit tight with the others, Miss Osterhagen.
Don't worry about me, I'll be out of here in no time.
Nobody try any funny business, okay? I don't want to get in trouble again.
I'll be right here if you need anything. Bailey says I have to keep an eye on you.
Thanks, Jimmy!
Arthur? Is that you?
It's me!
So, how did your interrogation go?
I'm sure Lamont and Bailey are fun, once you get to know them.
Is somebody flushing contraband?
You better stop that right n-
Auuugh!
Ha ha! I got hold of his keys!
Enjoy your nap, pal!
That was quite the explosion.
My sleuthing arm, I think it's bruised.
It was a sloppy solution, but we stopped the train!
We sure did. Plus, nobody got hurt!
What the hell is going on here? We came as soon as we saw the explosion.
Thank goodness you're here, officers! These three villains plotted to kill my dear sister!
Never mind that, they deliberately crashed the train!
My financial records have surely been destroyed!
Oh yes? Well, they endangered my staff and sabotaged my kitchen!
My allergies, they were exploited for personal gain!
I was tricked into reading this phoney manuscript!
My clients are still buried under that rubble!
She'll be right, mate!
Is all of that true?
Cuff 'em, Bailey. They're coming to the station for questioning.
Not to mention smuggling a private detective onboard, who made great effort to act out in highly suspicious, and unpredictable ways.
It turns out Lady Unterwald had one last trick up her sleeve, switching the informant out for her estate attorney.
Come on, Arthur. It's time to put an end to this!
He's got a gun!
Get to the engine room, Diana! Stop the train!
I'm not leaving you!
Go!
Thought you could steal Lady Unterwald's estate, did you?
What? No!
I've worked too hard for too long for you to mess it all up!
I'm afraid your Will has been revoked. I tore it to shreds with my own two hands!
That's a criminal offence, you know!
Maybe so, but it's the end of the line for you, Arthur A. Ackerman!
Goodbye! Any last words?
